text:
leila: starting NewWave-7B int4 bring-up. quick smoke on TL;DR benchmark shows odd noun duplication and token-level perplexity spike. logs below. anyone seen casefolding causing this? :thinking_face:

omar: paste the eval + tokenizer steps pls

leila: ran `./tools/onboard --model newwave7b --quant int4-staggered` then smoke eval `pytest tests/tldr_smoke.py::test_newwave`

snip logs:
```
LOADING NewWave-7B
APPLY QUANT PROFILE: int4-staggered (per-tensor fallback)
TOKENIZER: applied casefold + unicode nfkc normalization
WARN: tokenizer: ascii-fallback sequences created for some emotive unicode
EVAL: TLDR-F1=0.48 (fp16 baseline 0.66)
EVAL: avg_logprob=-2.21 (baseline -1.30)
GENERATED: duplicate noun pattern: "product product" (p=0.09)
```

zane: casefold/nfkc can collapse variants which changes token ordering. did the converter reorder indices or assign ascii-fallback tokens into middle of vocab?

omar: also note int4-staggered quant uses a different scale per-head-group; small id permutation could change rotary sin/cos alignment if we index them by token-id rather than embedding position.

leila: quick diff of vocab: 41 entries remapped, most are upper->lower merges and ascii fallback entries. interestingly fp16 run identical tokenizer -> fine. suspect interaction of quant noise + rotary index lookup.

zane: run two quick experiments: (A) disable casefold in tokenizer and run int4-staggered, (B) keep casefold but set rotary_base=embedding_index (instead of token-id) if runtime supports it.

leila: kick off A now. config: `tokenizer: casefold=false` same quant.

(ci-bot): job newwave-int4-nocasefold started

(ci-bot): job finished: TLDR-F1=0.63, avg_logprob=-1.37, duplicates gone. :white_check_mark:

omar: that strongly suggests token-id permutation from normalization broke the rotor/phase alignment assumption. disabling casefold kept ids stable so int4 behaved. good repro.

zane: long-term we should avoid token-id dependent rotary mapping. short-term add a converter flag `preserve_casefold_aliases=true` to pin merged tokens into original id slots. also add `rotary_perm_check` to conversion CI.

leila: created ticket ML-5120 "NewWave7B: casefold-induced token id remap -> rotary misalignment on int4-staggered" assigned to eng-ml + eng-runtime. added manifest flag `tokenizer_preserve_aliases: true` for now. uploading diffs to s3://rdw-onboard/newwave7b/int4-diffs/

omar: I'll prototype a runtime option `rotary_index_source: embedding_index` and measure perf hit. if small we should flip it to avoid whole class of vocab shuffles.

zane: added unit test `eng-ml/tests/rotary_tokenid_vs_embeddingidx.py` that permutes vocab indices and asserts identical attention phase outputs within tolerance. will hook to conversion PRs.

eval-bot: scheduled full-run diff job for int4 vs fp16 (prefix s3://rdw-onboard/newwave7b/full-diffs/).

leila: thanks team — will monitor overnight and update INF/ML ticket tomorrow :rocket:
